source.title: Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Senate President, the Presiding Officer, and the Senator-Judges of the Impeachment Court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Sergeant

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: at Arms is directed to make a proclamation.

turns.speaker: Alfredo Sotto Corpuz
turns.text: All persons are commanded to keep silent under pain of penalty while the Impeachment Court is in session for the trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte is hereby called to order. We shall be led in prayer by Senator-Judge Erwin Tulfo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Sa

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: ngalan ng Ama ng Anak na Espiritu Santo, Amen. Aming mapagmahal na Diyos, bigyan mo po ng malinaw na pag-iisip, malinis na konsensya at matatag na panihindigan ang mga senador na nagsisilbing mga hukom ngayon. Nawa'y maging patas at walang kinikilingan ang aming paghatol. Hindi dahil sa politika, personal na interes, opinion ng publiko o anumang impluensya. Higit sa lahat, Panginoon, huwag mong hayaang ang hatul ay maimpluensyahan ng social media. Naway hindi siya mahatulan dahil lamang sa ingay ng mga opinion online at hindi rin siya mapawalang sala dahil sa popularidad o suporta ng iba. Ang maging batayan lamang sana ay ang katotohanan Ang batas at ang mga ebidensya ang iniharap sa paglilitis. Kung tunay nga na walang sala si Vice President Sara Duterte, bigyan mo ng tapang at karunungang kaming mga hukom na siya ay agad na mapawalang sala. Ngunit, kung ang mga ebidensya ay malinaw, matibay at sapat upang patunayang siya ay nagkasala, bigyan mo rin kami ng katatagaan na siya ay panagutin na naaayon sa batas. Panginoon, naway maging mabilis ngunit makatarungan ang paglilitis na ito. Huwag naway itong patagalin ng walang sapat na dahilan sa pagkatunay na ang kasabihang justice delayed is justice denied. Sa huli, naway hindi ang politika, social media o popular na opinion ang manaig kundi ang katotohanan, katarungan at kapakanan ng sambayan ng Pilipino. Ito ang aming sinasamo sa inyo, Panginoon. Amen.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Amen. The Clerk of Court will now call the roll.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.

turns.text: Your Honor, I understand that this is a continuation of the direct testimony of our witness. May we request the counsel for the prosecutor, Atty. Kapunin, be recognized, Your Honor, please.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: How is your platform, ma 'am?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: I pray that I do not fall from the apple cart. Your Honor, please, good morning, Mr. Presiding Officer, Honorable Impeachment Senate Judges, Senate Court Judges. We are disturbed, Your Honor. Although yesterday we terminated our direct examination, we are disturbed by a manifestation of counsel for the respondent when she said that the marking of the tabulations and summaries will no way be an admission, Your Honor, as to the authenticity of the acknowledgement receipts which form part of the tabulation and the summary, Your Honor. We therefore are constrained unless council now is willing to stipulate that the summaries which really and the tabulation which was really personally prepared by this competent witness of the COA ICFAO which office received and all acknowledgement receipts have an attestation that they are certified true copies of the person who has custody of the same, Your Honor. May we inquire from counsel of respondent if again, although the presiding officer did make it clear that when each individual acknowledgement receipt is presented, they have the right to cross-examine. And we have the right to ask the witness. Our concern, Your Honor, is the next witnesses that we will be presenting will not have any personal knowledge of this acknowledgement receipts. They will not be able to identify and authenticate. The only person who can do that, Your Honor, is the current witness, Sylene May del Campo. Now, we are constrained, Your Honor. To save the time of this honorable court, this presiding officer will recall that it also ordered, Your Honor, that the prosecution and the defense submit separately the list of documents, specifically acknowledgement receipts, to the Clerk of Court which office will be the one to make the comparison, Your Honor. Can we modify that order, Your Honor? Can we request, Your Honor, that in addition to the Clerk of Court comparing comparing the prosecution evidence and the defense evidence, an exercise which should have been done Thursday and Friday last week, Your Honor, that instead of just doing that, that this witness appear before the clerk of court to identify and authenticate, Your Honor, these documents in front of the prosecution, in front of the defense. and in front of the Clerk of Court. Thereafter, the Clerk of Court can make a finding or report or evaluation that these documents, I'm sorry, that these documents were properly identified, authenticated by this witness, Your Honor, to preempt any technical legal objection in the future. because, Your Honor, or in the formal offer, Your Honor, because counsel will recall, and this court will recall that while we had already ended our direct examination, counsel for respondents said that does not mean that this witness identified and authenticated the acknowledgement receipts. And therefore, Your Honor, if we may respectfully request the presiding officer to authorize or to designate the Clerk of Court to accept,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Your Honor, not only the documents but likewise for this witness to appear before the Clerk of Court in front of counsels for both respondent and the prosecution to enable this witness to identify and authenticate based on personal knowledge, Your Honor, the documents that are part of the summaries, Your Honor. This way, Your Honor, we will not have to present again acknowledgement receipts this morning and identify each and every one. So, in sum, Your Honor, my manifestation is to the effect that we expand The directive of the presiding officer directing

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: the parties to separately submit their documents and for the clerk to himself, itself, clerk of court's office to itself, make the comparison. We want to expand it to include that this witness, Ms. Silene, appear before the clerk of court. in the presence of counsels for the petitioner and for the respondent for the purpose of one, identifying, and two, authenticating the documents in the tabulation, sir. This will save the court two hours today. Your Honor,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: please. Counsel, before you respond, Attorney Christine, Counsel, Does your manifestation have anything to do with the fact that you've wound up your direct? Does that mean you intend to proceed with your direct again today?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: No, Your Honor. So your

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: It's a manifestation

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan

If the presiding officer will allow this witness to appear before the clerk of court, In front of both councils, Your Honor, for the purpose of identifying and authenticating the documents presented, Your Honor, then we will terminate our direct examination.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I believe you already did yesterday, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan

So, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: In the interest of moving forward, don't worry, Atty. Sailin. No need to comment. The Chair will make a ruling. Last night, The acknowledgement receipts that came from the counsel for respondents were submitted already to the Clerk of Court for comparison with the ARs of the prosecution. Both are certified through copies, although some ARs are certified by a different certifying officer from COA, but both are certified through copies and we will proceed with the comparison. It was clear from the witness yesterday and it's clear to the court that she based her tabulation on the ARs that she said were all certified by the same person. That's your copy, counsel. And we took note of that and acknowledged that. These are certified true copies from both sides as you will compare to avoid that situation from happening. And we will be ruling on the admissibility of these ARs once it is formally offered based on this comparison. Without need for Silene really to tell us that they look alike or are alike. But counsel, as of yesterday, insofar as the randomly picked or well-chosen ARs yesterday, counsel for the respondent did not raise their copies. Apparently, or we will know now at cross, apparently there is no discrepancy or difference when you are presenting those ARs to the witness.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And again, that is their right. to present their copy because their theory is they're questioning, correct me if I'm wrong, Atty. Sailin, the chain of custody. It might have been broken. But if it's not broken insofar as the ARs and after we compare it, then there is no need to further belabor this point. We will rule on the matter, counsel, at the appropriate time. But I'm telling you already where the court is at this point in time in relation to the ARs that Sailin testified to and where she based her tables and summaries upon. And that is the copies of the prosecutor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I hope that settles the issue, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer. I think with that ruling, it is now clear that identification and authentication are presumed from the statement of the Presiding Officer subject to cross-examination. of counsel for the respondent, Your Honor. And

turns.text: subject to the comparison that the clerk will be making of these copies coming from both parties, which you will make known to the parties without need of Silene's presence thereat.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan

With that, Your Honor, unless counsel...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.text: Just

turns.speaker: Atty. Kristine R. Ferrer
turns.text: So, tinanong ko kayo kanina about the OVP or the SDO, in that regard, disbursing monies in one day. in several places. Sinabi ko, isang araw, madaming mga pinag-gastusan, isang date lang yun, iba-ibang lugar. May findings po ba nito sa first ending ninyo? Wala po kasi we presume

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: regularity po doon sa transaction po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Kristine R. Ferrer
turns.text: Okay,

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: thank you. How about sa second ending po ninyo? May findings po ba nito? Dahil nga po nag-base kami sa certification under oath ng SDO, wala po. Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Kristine R. Ferrer
turns.text: Okay, so...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Kristine R. Ferrer
turns.text: Okay, Your Honor, I'm done, Your Honor. Thank you,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: counsel. We now move. Hopefully, we can finish with Cylene today. Cylene, with your patience and indulgence. Senator Padilla. Is he here? Not here? Senator Ontiveros, then, for her interjections.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: With the kind indulgence of Senator Ontiveros, Senator Padilla just arrived. Senator Padilla. You may proceed, sir. You have two minutes. You may proceed when you're ready. Maraming salamat po, ginong Tagapamahal ng Hukom.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Sa ating saksi, kayo po ay taga-Bagyo?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Yes po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Saan po kayo sa Bagyo?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Irizan po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Irizan. Opo. Ako po ay taga-Bagyo din. Saan po kayo nag-graduate? Sa St.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Louis University po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Ay, alumnus po ako niyan. Sa Boys High po ako. Dahil po dyan, hindi ko nalang po kayo pahihirapan. Tayo nalang po ay maging magkababayan nalang sa Baguio. Gusto ko lamang pong magbigay ng informasyon nalang sa inyo. Opo kasi naririnig ko yung pag-uusap nyo ng prosecution at ng defense tungkol doon sa success nung confidential fund. Ako po ay may mga ibibigay na information sa inyo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: pwede po kayong magsabi na lang ng oo o hindi kung naiintindihan po ninyo. Alam ko naman naiintindihan mo, taga Baguio kayo. Opo, noon pong pinag-uusapan natin yung

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: patungkol sa mga terorista na pag-uusapan po lagi ang ating vicepresidente. Ang ating pong vicepresidente, magmula 2016 hanggang 2022, siya po ay naging mayor. Alam niyo po ba iyon?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Opo, Mayor ng Davao.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Yan, opo. Sa Davao po, meron po dyan na-identify na 55 na mga tinatawag na alternative at yung mga lumad schools na infiltrated ng terrorism. Nabalitaan nyo po ba yun?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Hindi po ako gaano na, hindi ko po gaano na napakinggan po yun. Hindi po ako aware doon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Opo. At alam niyo po ba rin na noong 2016 hanggang 2022 hanggang 2023, 12% po ng mga NPA rebels, surrenderees, were minors, 12 to 17 years old.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Hindi po ako aware dun po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Maubos na po yung aking second round na lang po ako. Salamat kabayan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Padilla. Senator Ontiveros is recognized for her interjections. You have two minutes, ma'am. You may proceed.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Salamat po, Mr. Presiding Officer. Ms. Witness, Ms. Silene, kahit pa po walang confidential at intelligence funds ang OVP, may budget naman po ang VPSG para sa security ng lahat ng vicepresidente, di po ba?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Under po sila ng AFP. Under

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: ng AFP. Ngayon, tatlong taon na pong walang intelligence and confidential funds ang OVP. Kung alam nyo, may VPSG pa naman pong naka-assign sa kanila para bantayan yung kanyang siguridad, diba?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Sa pagkakaalam ko po, nabanggit po kanina ni presiding officer na punta siya sa PSC, Presidential Security Command po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Ngayon,

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: iyong mga activities na nandoon sa mga Protective Intelligence Operations Reports na pinakita kanina, may binigay bang mga ebidensya ang OVP? para patunayan na ginastusan nga po nila ang bawat isa nun.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Wala po kasi in-attach lang po nila yun as proof of success of information gathering and surveillance activities.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Na ayon sa inyo kanina ay hindi pa sasapat dun sa hinahanap n'yong mga proofs of success dun sa intelligence gathering activities na iyon.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Opo, tama po. Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Ngayon, sa iba namang mga acknowledgement receipts, may nakalagay na purchase of medical and food aid at dati naman medicines. May resibo po ba silang ibinigay para ipakita na talagang ang binayaran o ang binili ay yung mga gamot o yung mga pagkain na iyan?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Wala po silang inattach na any receipts po or sales invoice. Acknowledgement receipts po.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Kahit sales invoice, wala. Acknowledgement receipts lamang. Opo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Kristine R. Ferrer
turns.text: So, walang ebidensya na talagang ang pinagkagastusan ay yung mga gamot at yung mga pagkain na yun.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Opo kasi based lang doon sa acknowledgement receipts po yung sinubmit nila.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Na ayon sa COA ay hindi sapat na ebidensya kung mga ARs lamang.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Opo, hindi po kasi namin ma-ascertain kung talagang pinambili ito ng supplies, medicines, and food po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Kailangan nyo resibo o invoices para ma-assertin masiguro na yun talaga yung pinagkagastusan.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Opo, tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Okay. Ngayon po, Ms. Aileen, dati po, tinawag ng land bank managers na unusual yung pag-encash ng milyong-milyong pisong, daang-milyong, daan-daang-milyong piso ng OVP at saka ng DepEd sa tigi-isang araw. Sa audit po ninyo, Meron po ba kayong nakitang illegal, improper, o irregular sa paggamit at sa pag-liquidate ng perang iyan?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Irregular po yung paggamit nila kasi po hindi po ito compliant with the Joint Circular. So

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: just to close on this, Mr. Presiding Officer, to wind up, irregular dahil...

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: hindi po naging compliant.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Paano hindi

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: naging compliant? Dahil po ngayon sa payment of rewards, we're not supported with documents evidencing success. And yun nga po, hindi nila na-provide yung additional

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: documents necessary para ma-ascertain yung purchase of supplies and medical and food aid. At saka po, meron din kaming naging findings sa reimbursement po. Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: I-follow up ko itong tanong at pati yung punto ng reimbursement sa second round. Salamat, Ms. Aileen. Salamat, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Senator-Judge Villanueva, you have two

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: minutes. You may proceed when you're ready. Unless Senator-Judge Lapid is ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Senator-Judge Villanueva, well, I will give way

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: to Senator Lapid. Mr. President, thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: Ms. Del Campo, sabi niyo po yung COA conducted compliance audit at sa evaluation niyo ng OVP's confidential expenses. Which matters po? Did COA treat as questions of compliance with the Joint Circular? And which matters? Did COA recognize as falling within the operational judgment of the implementing agency?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Clarify po yung question.

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: Which matters po doon sa pag-conduct ng COA, treating it as questions of compliance with the Joint Circular? And which matters doon po sa paggawa ng COA, recognizing it as falling within the operational judgment ng Office of the Vice President?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Yung pag-evaluate po namin ng mga liquidation documents, binibase po namin yun sa Joint Circular. Yung sa Office of the Vice President po, yung pag-liquidate po dapat nila, it is based po dapat sa Joint, should be compliant with the Joint Circular.

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: Dapat pareho lang. So when COVID disagreed? na yung OVP's characterization that an activity was confidential, necessary, and successfully accomplished, what specific standards po yung ina-apply n'yo?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: The Joint Circular po ang basis ng aming audit.

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: Wala na pong ibang separate COA guidelines?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Ginagamit din po namin yung Rules and Regulations on Settlement of Accounts. I'm

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: sorry?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: The Rules and Regulations on Settlement of Accounts. And

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: ito po, same standards applied consistently to all. The transactions reviewed.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Opo, tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: Salamat po. Kapag nag-issue po ang COA ng Notice of Disallowance, maaari pa po bang itong ma-cure simply by correcting, replacing, or subsequently submitting supporting documents?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Yung sa Notice of Disallowance po, appeal po sa commission proper ang remedy po ng isang agency. So kailangan

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: kang dumaan, provided ng COA rules, para ma-lift o ma-reverse yung ND. Is that correct? Can you explain the process?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Pag nag-issue po kasi si ICFAO ng Notice of Disallowance, may demand na po to restitute the amount. Pero may remedy pa din po yung agency na mag-appeal po sa commission proper. Commission

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: proper o co-director?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Commission, yung sa case po ng ICFAO, diretso na po sa commission proper ang appeal.

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: Tapos, puwedeng mag-MR?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Kung magkakaroon po ng decision, kaya nga po nang nangyari sa fourth quarter 2022 na meron silang, yung decision is na-affirm yung ND, opo, meron pa pong remedy na MR. Tapos

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: pwedeng mag-judicial review?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Pag-petition for certiorari po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: Okay. So, yung

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: pong pag-correct o pag-submit ng additional document ay hindi by itself equivalent sa legal lifting o reversal ng ND.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Depende po yan sa evaluation na po ng sa Commission proper.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Kailangan action

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: lang ng proper, Koa. Malinaw po yan. Last na po. Para malinaw po sa atin lahat, kung ang isang agency ay nag-classify ng isang activity as confidential, bound po ba ang Koa sa classification na ito o bilang constitutional audit body? Hindi po.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Yung sa confidentiality po, pag naipasa naman po sa amin, iniingatan din po namin yung mga documents na nasasubmit sa amin. And what we do po is yung kung tama ba yung paggamit ng confidential funds na ibinigay po sa isang ahensya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: Ulitin ko po yung tanong, ulitin ko po yung tanong. Hindi kayo bound. Hindi kayo bound na ang isang ahensya dineclare confidential funds ito. Hindi kayo bound dahil as a constitutional body, meron po kayong independent evaluation. As commission on audit para yung malaman kung isang activity at expenditure ay talagang confidential in nature at pasok ito sa definition at allowable uses under the Joint Circular.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Yes po kasi itong confidential fund is pondo po ng bayad na kailangan ma-audit at magkaroon ng proper maging ano tawag dito, ma-check kung ito ay nagamit ba sa tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: Again, hindi kayo bound. Pag dineclare ng isang ahensya, ito confidential funds, hindi kayo bound.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Hindi po, kasi nga kailangan i-liquidate pa din po properly. Tama

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: po yun, and I support that sa Constitution, Article 9D, Section 2, 1 and 2, COA has the power and duty to examine, audit, and settle accounts involving government funds and the exclusive authority, kayo ho, yung may exclusive authority to define the scope of your audit. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Opo, tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: So, ibig sabihin ang polisiya po ninyo hindi po sapat na tawaging confidential ng isang ahensya ang isang activity subject pa rin po ito sa independent audit determination ng Commission on Audit. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Yes po, tama po. Dahil nga po ito ay pondo ng bayan at kailangan po na ma-audit ito ng takot.

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: At nung ginawa po nyo ito, ilang beses po silang nabigyan ng pagkakataon para sumagot?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Yung sa fourth quarter 22, dumaan po ito ng AOM, naging NS, naging ND. Yung sa 2023 naman po, AOM, tapos naging ND dahil nga po may direct violation of the joint circular.

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid
turns.text: Salamat po sa pagklaro ng proseso. Salamat. Senator

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: -Judge Pangilinan, you may proceed with your interjection when you're ready. You have two minutes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Thank you. Magandang hapon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Sa usapin noong December 21 to December 31, 2022, na ginastos yung 125 million. Pag hindi naubos yung 125 million by December 31, anong mangyayari sa pondo?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Babalik po yun sa National Treasury.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So ibig sabihin, hindi may babalik sa savings ng OVP? Babalik sa National Treasury?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Apo. I'm

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: trying to understand bakit. Diba? Ang ikli nung panahon, which you mentioned, maikli yung 11 days, but wala kayong finding, no? Ngayon, kung halimbawa nagsumiti sila ng mga dokumento para mapatunayan na tama lahat mong ginastos nung 21 to 31, di walang issue, hindi ba? Kung nasummit nila yung mga hinihiling ninyong additional documents.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Yes, po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay. Pero dahil hindi nila sinumiti, Hindi n'yo alam kung tama nga ba yung gastos noong December 21 to December 31. Tama?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Opo, dahil hindi po nila na-explain mabuti.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay. Of course, hindi n'yo malalaman kung iligal o irregular, pero hindi n'yo rin malalaman kung legal o regular.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Doon po siya magpa-fall sa irregular kasi nga po hindi siya compliant with the Joint

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Circular. Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Kristine R. Ferrer
turns.text: Hindi n'yo malalaman... kung napunta sa personal use o hindi. Tama? That's why you're asking for more documents.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Oo po. Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay, okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So, kaya siguro, well, so kung hindi niya nagastos, babalik.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Oo po, sa national treasure.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: At hindi niya maaaring gastusin sa January.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Hindi na po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Hindi rin niya maaaring gastusin before December 21.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Hindi po kasi bawal po ang reimbursement.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So talagang doon mo lang magagasos?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Yes po, doon sa nakalagay na period of utilization of the cash advance.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Which could be valid, dahil yun nga lang ang panahon, or invalid. Dangan nga lang, kaya kayo humihingi ng dagdag na dokumento para malaman natin kung valid ba o hindi.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Opo, tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay. Yung usapin ng protective...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: intelligence operations.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Dati wala namang confidential funds ang OVP, tama?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Opo, magmula na nag-start po ako sa ICVAO.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Pero dati meron ng protective services ang OVP.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Sa pagkakaalam ko po, yung under the PSG po ata sila.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So yung gastos para sa security, dati sa PSG.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Pero dito lumalabas yung casing, security, appointment ay ginastos o ginamit yung confidential funds. Tama ba yun?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Next

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: round na lang po. Thank you, Senator-Judge Pangilinan. Senator-Judge Aquino may proceed with his interjection when he's ready. You have 10 minutes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Presiding Officer. Magandang araw po.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Good afternoon po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Sa inyo pong determinasyon sa inyong opisina, meron pong mga disallowances, no? Tungkol po sa kategorya ng mga gastos, kung sino po yung nag-disperse. Pero hindi po naging rason ng disallowance yung mga kakaibang pangalan. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Opo, tama po. Pero

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: nakita po ninyo na may mga pangalan na kakaiba. May peyatos, may bacon. Hart, Queso, at kung ano-ano, hindi nyo po naisip na baka red flag po ito?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Dahil nga po ang audit namin is compliance lang po, hindi na po namin binerify yung identity nung nakatanggap po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Pero nung, hindi nyo binerify, pero nung nakikita ninyo, o nung nakikita mo, hindi mo ba naisip na posibleng red flag itong mga pangalan to?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: We presume po kasi regularity kasi po merong certification under oath yung SDO. This was used for the confidential operations of the agency. And these are necessary and for legal purpose po yung naging paggastos ng confidential fund.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Okay. So nag-consult na kasi yung iba naming abogado kay former Commissioner Heidi Mendoza. At sabi niya, kapag may mga kakaibang pangalan, The COA can trigger an investigation because of fraud. So hindi nyo po ginawa yun, walang usapin ng investigation because of fraud.

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Yung sa fraud audit po kasi, pinag-aaral, yung possibility po, pinag-aaral pa kasi kung magpo-fraud audit po, this is the first time. And yung documents po, yung transactions involving the OBP and DepEd po, contains voluminous documents na with sensitive information na pag naibigay po sa ibang opisina, baka po magiging exposed siya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Okay. So, ulitin ko ha. So, hindi kayo nag-trigger ng investigation of fraud? Or nag-trigger kayo?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Wala pa po. Pinag-aaralan pa po with the chairperson.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Ah, pinag-aaralan. So, it's possible na magkaroon pa ng investigation due to fraud?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo
turns.text: Ah, pinag-aaralan pa lang po. At kung kinakailangan po, pwede pong... mag-fraud audit po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Okay. Let me ask about what is fraud, no? Ano yung fraudulent? Yung paggamit ba ng alias ay fraudulent?

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Ito ba

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: 'y bawal or iligal?

turns.speaker: Cylene May L. Del Campo

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Being cordial or nice or kind but it's a basic violation of Rule 18. I already talked to the parties two weeks ago reminding you that you might want to consider appointing spokespersons who are not part of the panel of prosecutors nor a private prosecutor but you insist on maintaining that. So after two weeks, the court is constrained to make a decision and ruling on that. But we will do that on Monday with the permission of both counsels. Then we will hear you, counsel, and we will hear Attorney Ligutan prior to the court's ruling on the matter. But be advised that again, we have it all on tape. We have been monitoring everything. We may not enumerate it one by one. but we will make the corresponding ruling on Monday. Thank you for bringing that up, counsel. It gives me a reason to actually issue the ruling which we have prepared and have been preparing the past few days. On Monday, Attorney Ligutan, we will hear you before we make the ruling. Thank you. There being no other matter to be taken up by the trial and by the court, we hereby adjourn until Monday, August 17, still at 10 a.m.

turns.speaker: Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
